extracted.name: Yummy Bok Choy Salad
extracted.description: This is hands down the best salad that I've ever had. A homemade vinaigrette perfectly accents this simple salad of fresh baby bok choy, green onions, and toasted almonds.
ingredient_lines: 2 bunches baby bok choy, cleaned and sliced
instruction_lines: In a glass jar with a lid, mix together olive oil, white vinegar, sugar, and soy sauce. Close the lid, and shake until well mixed.
Combine the bok choy, green onions, almonds, and chow mein noodles in a salad bowl. Toss with dressing, and serve.
